conventions.convention: Assume Countable Choice. The metric is prescribed on all of R⁴: g=Ω²η, η=diag(-1,1,1,1), with Ω smooth, real, strictly positive and dimensionless. No boundedness at infinity or metric field equation is assumed.
Curvature uses R(X,Y)Z=∇X∇YZ−∇Y∇XZ−∇[X,Y]Z, and the conformal wave operator is Pg=□g−Rg/6.
Tests are complex compactly supported smooth functions with the locally convex LF test-function topology. Field equalities hold on the common invariant finite-particle domain or distributionally.
The Hilbert pairing is second-variable-linear; Φμ(f)=a(Kμ conjugate(f))+a†(Kμf) is complex-linear. Vacuum two-point distributions are paired bilinearly with the two tests.
The massless shell has ω₀(k)=|k| and measure d³k/((2π)³2|k|), with its apex omitted. K₀f(p)=∫f(x)exp(i(p⁰x⁰−p·x))d⁴x.
Curved smearing uses Φg(f)=Φ₀(Ω³f); the positive volume density is Ω⁴d⁴x. The displayed two-point kernel is relative to the curved volume in both variables.

load_bearing.statement: Under Countable Choice and the stated smooth positive conformal metric and massless Fock conventions, Rg=−6Ω⁻³□ηΩ and Pg(Ω⁻¹u)=Ω⁻³□ηu for every smooth complex u. Φg(f)=Φ₀(Ω³f) is a weak operator-valued distribution on compact tests, satisfies Φg(Pgf)=0, has a normalized positive vacuum state, and commutes for spacelike-separated test supports. Its curved-volume two-point kernel is Ω(x)⁻¹Ω(y)⁻¹W₀(x,y), and Pg is formally symmetric on compact tests.

published_dependencies.used_for: Fixed-support derivative seminorms controlling multiplication by Ω³ and compact-test distribution estimates.
Precise locally convex LF topology on compact smooth tests.
Passing from continuous fixed-support restrictions to continuous linear maps on the full test space.
Weighted derivative bounds, compact-support inclusion estimates and Fourier decay estimates.
Continuity and decay of Fourier transforms used in massless shell restriction and the two-point bidistribution.
Bounded contraction extensions and finite-sector annihilation estimates.
Orthogonal symmetrizers of norm at most one and creation-operator sector bounds.
Christoffel formula, giving the vanishing flat connection and curvature in global Minkowski coordinates.
Exact curvature sign, component order and scalar contraction convention.

seams_checked.note: Opened the supplier page and thm-emg-conformal-einstein-transformation. Its scalar formula Ω⁻²(S−6θ−6s), with u=Ω⁻¹dΩ and the stated curvature convention, specializes exactly to Rg=−6Ω⁻³□ηΩ. Smoothness, positivity, signature and inherited Countable Choice are retained; no Einstein-equation invariance is inferred.

Opened the supplier page, mass-shell definition, smeared-field lemma and causal-commutator lemma, together with the Fock definition. The consumer retains μ=0, the Fourier and pairing conventions, invariant finite-particle domain and bilinear covariance. Real-test locality is explicitly extended to complex tests by decomposition. Continuity and the massless field equation are derived locally, and draft status is acknowledged.
